description: This file is a Python module that is part of the mypy plugin system for the PyTorch project. It defines functions to retrieve the correct mypy version from a requirements file and to provide a plugin interface that verifies the current mypy version against the required one, issuing instructions if mismatched.

classes.name: Plugin
classes.description: A class imported from mypy.plugin, used as a return type for the plugin function.

methods.name: get_correct_mypy_version()
methods.description: Reads the requirements-ci.txt file to extract and return the correct mypy version as specified in the file.

methods.name: plugin(version: str)
methods.description: Defines a mypy plugin that checks the current mypy version against the required version and outputs instructions if there is a mismatch.
